history.overview: The Ritual Chambers are where Riftseekers perform planar rites to stabilize fractures, bind Discord energy, and manipulate rift flows.

timeline.name: Ritual Chambers Constructed
timeline.description: Riftseekers built the chambers to conduct planar rites safely.

timeline.name: Ritual Pylons Installed
timeline.description: Pylons were added to amplify ritual energy and stabilize planar flows.

timeline.name: Muramite Disruptions
timeline.description: Muramite forces attempted to disrupt rituals to collapse Sanctum defenses.

timeline.name: Discord Ritual Failures
timeline.description: Failed rituals caused Discord manifestations to erupt from planar fractures.
